text: Supply Station Battle (Japanese: , Hokyū Shisetsu Teishi Sakusen) is a Story Quest in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received automatically at the Main Control Room together with Turbine Battle while progressing through the first basement floor of Galahad Fortress.

Summon Wind (Japanese: , Samon Windo) is one of Melia's summon arts in and . Each wind element summoned increases Melia's and her allies' agility by 10% within the area effect. When the Wind Element is discharged, enemies within 4 meters of the target will receive damage.

Surprise quests are quests in that appear automatically when certain conditions are met. There are twelve surprise quests in the game; nine (ten in ) are Timed Quests. Some surprise quests are triggered by entering an area at the right time, while others activate as part of a larger quest chain. Note that although Gather Information will later disappear, the game does not identify it as a timed quest (except in Definitive Edition). There are two surprise quests in . = Timed Quest

Suelo Orluga are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles. They are members of the Orluga family, and can be found at level 43 near the Pod Landing Site in Makna Forest. They can drop the Orluga Grass Skirts required for Alcamoth's Material Quest 2.

The Sureny Telethia (Japanese: , Surēni Tereshia) is a Boss in . It is a Drakos-type member of the Telethia family, and is only fought twice — on the deck of the Junks during a battle event, and at Colony 6's Main Entrance during the second round of the story event battle. During both fights it does not drop treasure chests, and none of the items it carries can be stolen. It is Dickson's Telethia.

The Supply Road (Japanese: , Koroni 6 Hokyūro) is a landmark in . It is located at the northern entrance to Colony 6 from Bionis' Leg. However, when the party first enters Colony 6, they arrive at the Watchpoint Junction, just south of the Supply Road. Backtracking a small way is required to find it.

Sword Drones II (Japanese: , Sōdo Furappu 2) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones turn into four arms, slicing viciously at the targetted enemy with a ten hit combo. This talent art is available when Fiora has Uranus, Segment, or Sabre Drones equipped. es:Espada de Drones II

Sword Drones X (Japanese: , Sōdo Furappu 10) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones turn into four arms, slicing viciously at the targetted enemy with a ten hit combo. This talent art is available when Fiora has Sedna Drones equipped. es:Espada de Drones X
This page is a list of all the Unique Monsters in Sword Valley.
Strong Insect Legs are common materials designed for Xenoblade Chronicles. For unknown reasons they were cut from the game.
Strong Hox Horns are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Hoxes in Colony 6, or traded for.

Sword Drones I (Japanese: , Sōdo Furappu 1) is one of Fiora's Talent Arts in . Drones turn into four arms, slicing viciously at the targetted enemy with a ten hit combo. This talent art is available when Fiora has the Helwerthia Drones, Grizzly Drones, or Étoile Drones equipped. es:Espada de Drones I

The Supply Convoy Shop is a shop in . It is the lone shop in Sword Valley, located at the Supply Convoy. It is manned by a male Homs soldier. It specialises in anti-Mechon weapons, which do not require Topple or Monado Enchant to damage Mechon. Countering this benefit is the low base attack of these weapons as compared to other weapons available at this point in the game. Once the party reaches the end of Mechonis Field, this shop will be permanently inaccessible, as well as some items sold therein that cannot be obtained via alternate means.

Sunrise in the Park (Japanese: , Itsunohika Kōen de, Someday in the Park) is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located in Outlook Park in Colony 9, between Shulk and Fiora at yellow affinity. This is the only Heart-to-Heart that only requires yellow affinity.

The Stronger Telescope is a Key Item in Xenoblade Chronicles. It is received from Kaleka during Starlight Gazer after he has improved Miriall's Telescope, and must be delivered to Elior to complete the quest.

Sylvalum (Japanese: , Hakuju no Tairiku, lit. Land of White Wood; English dub: in the main game, in new content for the ) is a region in . It lies to the north of Primordia. This region is characterized by its white sandy terrain and exotic spherical trees. A massive glowing sphere can be seen over the southeastern part of the region. This region connects to Cauldros in the north. The Ganglion have a significant presence in Sylvalum, though not to the extent of Cauldros. Between Hilal Stronghold in the south, Badr Stronghold in the west, and Anvil Sandplain in the north, the Ganglion control most of the region. __TOC__
Suncatch Ravine (Japanese: , Hidamari no Kyōkoku) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, west of FN Site 211 and north of the Great Nail.

Sword Pugiliths (Japanese: , Sōdo Berudero) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Pugilith machines, Ganglion's vehicles, and can be found at level 26-29 at Big Arch, Mesa Fortress, and FN Site 305 in Oblivia. Another can be found at level 22 at the southern end of the Stoyanov Trail, and one can be found at level 30 in Sea Whisper Valley.

Sylooth (Japanese: , Shirūsu) are Humanoid enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are bipedal giants that seem both vegetal and fungal. They are not present in Cauldros but a similar species, Gularth, exclusively dwells in this volcanic region.

Sunlit Spring (Japanese: , Hinata Yūsui) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Noctilum, at the southwestern end of Goblin's Narrow. It is where the party fights Goetia. During the Normal Mission A Proper Chopper, Howard and Ciska are stranded here and require assistance in repairing their helicopter.

Striker Blattas (Japanese: , Sutoraiku Buratta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family, and can be found at level 17-20 in Oblivia near Oblivia Ingress and atop Big Arch during the day.
Surtr Scirpos (Japanese: , Suruto Shirunea) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Scirpos and can be found at level 21-27 in the Canopied Nightwood and Fukai Pass in Noctilum.

Suid Sweep is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Pathfinders and the primary destination is Primordia. It is a request to defeat four Brass Suids interfering with a Data Probe installation.

Sword Puges (Japanese: , Sōdo Berude) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Puge machines, Ganglion's human size robots, and can be found at level 21-23 or at level 26-30 in Sea Whisper Valley in Oblivia.

Striker Simius (Japanese: , Burou Shimiusu, Blow Simius) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Simius and can be found at level 33 in the Whale's Gullet, level 36-39 at Serpentine Pass and Cascade Isle, and level 38-39 at the base of Celestial Ascent in Noctilum.

Swift Evellos (Japanese: , Rapiddo Sutorutto, Rapid Evello) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Evello family, and can be found at level 33-36 in daytime at Talon Rock Second Terrane in Primordia.
Suriella is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is a member of the Mediators, and can be found at any time of day or night, but her location changes several times during the game.
The Sylvalum Collectopedia is a portion of the Collectopedia in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Subterfuge is one of many Debuff Arts in . It inflicts Debuff Res Down which reduces resistance to Debuffs.
Supershield is one of many Aura Arts in . It grants reflection of physical-attribute attacks along with other effects.
The Sylvalum Searoad (Japanese: , Kaiendō) is an area in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is located in Sylvalum, east of Delusians South Summit and between the Southern Searoad and the Northern Searoad.
The Sylvalum Waters (Japanese: , Hakuju no Tairiku Kinkai) are a region in . They are the waters surrounding Sylvalum.

Sweet Nerines (Japanese: , Suitanerine) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Primordia, in particular at Headwater Summit. Ten of them are needed for A Moment of Brilliance.

Sviatoslav, the Reproachful (Japanese: , Gaisei no Suvasutorafu) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Aprica family. It can be found at level 39 at Balance Rock in Oblivia during rainy weather. Defeating it is required to complete the eponymous Basic Mission Sviatoslav, the Reproachful. It can drop the Redwood Aprica Antlers needed for Mayhem. It reflects ether damage.
Sullivan (Japanese: , Sariban) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at the Integrated Production Plant in the Industrial District of New Los Angeles.
Sunset Falls (Japanese: , Sansetto Fōru) is a landmark in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is the area around a large magma waterfall located in Cauldros, directly adjacent to the Ternion Fork BC.
Suna Watermelons (Japanese: , Sunasuika) are rare collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Oblivia.
Strong Irons (Japanese: , Ittetsuaian) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be found in Oblivia. Five pieces of it are required for Booming Business.
Strobing Horseflies (Japanese: , Sutoroboabu) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Noctilum.
Superior Scepters (Japanese: , Neoerīto no Tamashaku) are unique collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Cauldros.
Supple Leathers are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Lepyxes, Cervuses, or Murras. Five of them are needed during The Fashionista.
Suid Fillets are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Suids in Primordia. One of them is needed to complete the mission Suid Sirloin.

Swift Blattas (Japanese: , Rapiddo Buratta, Rapid Blatta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Blatta family. They can be found at level 11-20 in Primordia inside the small cave atop Unicorn Rock, or at level 15 around a Suid corpse at East Gate Plain.
Suid Sirloin is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a Diner chef and the primary destination is Primordia.

The Support Trainee Qmoeva (Japanese: , Shien Kunren-gata Kumūba) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Qmoeva Ganglion's skell. It can be found at level 50 at Seaswept Base in Primordia atop the southeastern most building at night. It is inactive until approached.
Supple Tails are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Simius.

Survivor Germivores (Japanese: , Sabaibaru Burōsu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Germivore family, and can be found at level 42-43 around FN Site 414 and at level 45-46 on the Sylvalum Searoad in Sylvalum.
Stripped Platings are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Pugiliths in Primordia or Noctilum. Five of them are needed for The Handy Ma-non.

Strong Purgovent Extracts are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from light-colored Purgovents in Oblivia. They can also be brought for 114 Reward Tickets from the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Supplies Surprise (Japanese: , Seizon Daisakusen) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Nalu, who can be found northwest of Drongo Caravan in Cauldros, at the base of the cliff at the east edge of the segment above FN Site 502.
Swift Shrads (Japanese: , Rapiddo Zuttā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shrad machines, and can be found at level 41-50 at Kw'arah Cloister, north of FN Site 514 in Cauldros.
Supreme Sword is a Skill in . It is unlocked as a Blast Fencer at rank 10.

Striker Qmoevas (Japanese: , Sutoraikin Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 45 at the unnamed base on the plateau northwest of FN Site 415 in Sylvalum. They are dormant until approached.
Suppressor Hermit Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kabāhāmitto Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 51-60 in Primordia, near FN Site 102.

Suppressor Knight Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kabānaito Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 21-30 on the east shore at the base of Everwhelm Falls in Noctilum, appearing suddenly when the party comes within range.

Suppressor Queen Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kabākuīn Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 45 on an outcropping northeast of FN Site 407 and level 44 on the Sylvalum Searoad (near the Lifehold unit) in Sylvalum. They are dormant until approached.
Suppressor Rook Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kabārūku Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, and can be found at level 31-40 in Cauldros, near FN Site 505.
Sun'celeg is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean.
Sun'barac (Japanese: , Sunboiton) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is an Orphean who can be found at the Deck then at the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles.
Stun: Barrier is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It gives a chance to activate Barrier when Stunned.
Stun: Decoy is an armor Augment in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It gives a chance to activate Decoy when stunned.

Sun'celeg Rises (Japanese: , Gonin no Gijutsusha, Five Engineers) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received from Sun'barac on the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles. At the end of this mission, the other Orpheans use Senirapa Water on the dying Sun'celeg, triggering the birth of Tan'celeg and Ten'celeg.

The Suid Bones are an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is obtained from Conichien at the entrance of the Starboard of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles, and is needed to complete Trade Agreement.
Sylooth Tonic Water is a unique material in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from Sylooth.
Sundering Saltats is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Reclaimers to defeat two Jocular Saltats.

The Sword of Legendaryness is an Important Item in . It is a legendary Nopon sword for which Muimui searches over the course of several missions, culminating in The Sword of Legendaryness. The sword resembles the Monado from , but like most Nopon artifacts it is constructed of natural materials and has gold-colored decorations. The circular disc in the handguard lights up with the katakana character ポ (po).

The Strong Auravis (Japanese: , Sutorongu Akuira) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Auravis family, and is fought at level 32 on the North Janpath Plain in Primordia during Muimui's Meltdown.
Suid A is a Holofigure in . It depicts a purple suid variant. It can be obtained from Gugli, the Relentless, or Megatonne, the Hell Express in Primordia.
Sumptuous Sleeping is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from Dorian Caravan to obtain Eternal Moss in Noctilum.
Sweet Maple Goodness is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a diner chef and the primary destination is Cauldros.
Sylvalum Trailblazing 1 (Japanese: , Hakuju no Tairiku no Kaitaku 1) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Sylvalum Trailblazing 2 (Japanese: , Hakuju no Tairiku no Kaitaku 2) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X.
Sylvalum Trailblazing 3 (Japanese: , Hakuju no Tairiku no Kaitaku 3) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X.

Suspicious Minds is Mia's second Heart-to-Heart in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It occurs late at night in the Commercial District, one block south of West Melville Street, behind the piles of construction supplies.
Supreme Tank Tops are casual torso Armors made by Sakuraba Industries in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are available through several missions. All colors in this set have the same stats.

Supercivilization Attire is a casual full body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be seen as a upgraded version of L's Bodywear, and the counterpart of the Elite Supercivilization Attire. It can only be obtained through crafting and can only be equipped by male characters, and has the same appearance on all of them.
Suid B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green suid variant. It can be obtained from Olegario, the Iron-Helmed in Noctilum.
Sylooth A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green Sylooth variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Yama, the Obliviator in Noctilum.
Sylooth B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white Sylooth variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Anselm, the Triumphant in Sylvalum.
Sylooth C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a brown Sylooth variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Climati, the Chilling Wind in Oblivia.

Sylooth D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a golden Sylooth variant with coloration that resembles autumn foliage. It can be obtained from silver drops from Pyotr, the Shepherd in Noctilum.

Sword Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Sakuraba Industries Longsword. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Flora category of the Cauldros Collectopedia. The Sword weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Sword * Iron Sword * Carbide Sword * Cermet Sword * Chrome Sword * Chromoly Sword * Cobalt Sword * Titanium Sword * Ceramic Sword * Diamond Sword

Sword II Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Sakuraba Industries Longsword. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Xenotech category of the Cauldros Collectopedia. The Sword II weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Sword II * Iron Sword II * Carbide Sword II * Cermet Sword II * Chrome Sword II * Chromoly Sword II * Cobalt Sword II * Titanium Sword II * Ceramic Sword II * Diamond Sword II

Swarming Scavengers is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.17, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of collecting six Brambloo Shoots. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Supreme Angel Wings are a casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They share their appearance with the Relaxing Angel Wings, and are also available in black as the Soothing Angel Wings.
Supreme Angel Halos are casual head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They share their appearance with the other halos (Soothing Angel Halo, Warm Angel Halo).

The Subdued Arenatect (Japanese: , Darunesu Rorongu, Dullness Arenatect) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in . It is a level 40 member of the Arenatect family, and can be found attacking Lightning Strike at Sylvalum's Needle Rock Sandsea during The Line of Fire. The mission does not require the Arenatect to be fought.

Support Missions are a gameplay mechanic in Xenoblade Chronicles X. In the Japanese version, they are downloadable content, while in international versions they are unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed. They are intended to allow the player to quickly level up party members, raise affinity, and earn Credits and Miranium. They can be accepted at the Network Console, though they are not multiplayer missions and only allow solo play. They all have a time limit of 20 minutes, a maximum of 4 party members, and allow the use of Skells. They also have a limit of 3 retries, allowing an incapacitated player to be revived and continue the mission. The enemies in Support Missions do not drop any mater

Supply Run is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed, and allows a large amount of Credits and Miranium to be earned quickly. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Supreme Bonuses are Consumable Items in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be received as Division Rewards for Division activities. They can be sold for 30,000 Credits via the Inventory, and do not serve any other purpose.

Stun is a mobility debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Stun causes those afflicted with it to be unable to move and act for a few seconds. Playable characters and Skells have a special animation for being inflicted with Stun.

Subterranean Lake Galantia (Japanese: , Garenshia Chiteiko) is a Secret Area in . It is located on the Mid Level of Spirit Crucible Elpys. The area can be reached via a passage heading southeast near the entrance of the Middle Worm-Ridden Cave. It must be visited to unlock Finch's level 3 "Leaping" Field Skill. The Colla Carrot can be found here during Science Teacher. There are no enemies at the lake itself, but there is a Sygian Aspid and three Lun Scorpox on the path which are unavoidable.
The Strummer Deeds are Store Deeds in . They can be purchased from Strummer Instruments at Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild.

Stuffed Meaty Carrots are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased at Llysiau Greens run by Tenne in Torigoth, Gormott Province. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Finch. They can also be purchased for 180 G from the Pouch Item Emporium in the Land of Challenge after collecting the Nopon Invitation, Pt. 2 on Version 1.5.2 or later.
Sun-Dappled Curtains are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Neuromin Textiles in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Three are needed for A Hat Fit for a Lady.
Sweet Lentil Buns are Dessert Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Salter Sweets in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.
Strummer Instruments (Japanese: , Gakki Janjan) is a shop in . It is run by Nalinali and can be found in Goldmouth in the Argentum Trade Guild]. It is specialized in Instruments.

Supercharged Alfonso (Japanese: , Raigeki no Gigi) is a Unique Monster in . It is a member of the Garaffa family and can be found at level 20 at the Masrah Spring in the Gormott Province during low tide after reaching Torigoth. It must be defeated in order to unlock Zenobia's level 2 "The Indomitable" and Wulfric's level 2 Brutal Lance Affinity Rewards.
Stullon is an NPC in . Stullon is a Tantalese who can be found in Theosoir in the Kingdom of Tantal. Stullon runs a shop called Tatraty Fish specialized in Seafood.

Sunshine Pies are Meat Pouch items in . They can be created by Pyra at the kitchens in Tora's House and Corinne's House. She learns the recipe for this dish upon completing Fresh and Fruity. Two are needed for Crossette's level 5 Fortitude Field Skill.
Swooshing Slash (Japanese: , Zakuzaku surasshu) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Tora's arts when using a Variable Saber. Tora does a jumping rolling slash, then a horizontal slash.
Sweet Fliers (Japanese: , Suīto Furaia) are enemies in . They are members of the Flier family and can be found at level 21-23 on the Upper Level - Right of the Gormott Province.

Supporter Tirkin (Japanese: , Sapōtā Tākin) are enemies in . They are members of the Tirkin family and can be found at level 33-40 on the Upper Level - Right area of Gormott Province, particularly at the Tirkin Turf or Varnax's Plunge.

|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Sumpkins are Vegetable collectibles in and . They can be found in the Gormott Province, in particular at Dawnview Grotto, Kloom Farm, or Torigoth Flower Patch near Torigoth, or from the Collection Point located at Clear Sky Beak. They can be used to raise Pekka's Adult Ardun from level 60 to 80, each Sumpkin giving one progress point. Two of them are required to make Love Sources.
Strom Gyannas (Japanese: , Sutōmu Gyanomu) are enemies in . They are members of the Gyanna family and can be found at level 47 - 49 in the Old Quarry in the Kingdom of Uraya.

The Suspended Pathway (Japanese: , Kūchū Kairō) is a Secret Area in . It is scaffolding located on the outside of the Old Factory of the Empire of Mor Ardain. It can only be accessed during low tide, however, as the Disused Processing Plant's chute is blocked of by the Cloud Sea at high tide. The Level 3 "Wind Mastery" and Level 2 "Leaping" Field Skills are required to reach this area.
Sweet Armu Belly Stews are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Speck Butchers in Fonsett Village in the Leftherian Archipelago.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Swordfighting Banners (Japanese: , Kengeki no Hata) are accessories in and . They increase damage dealt against launched enemies by up to 60%. The Goddess Banner, Ancient Banner and War God Banner accessories offer stronger instances of this equipment's effect.

Sunset Clovers are Flower collectibles in . They can be found in the Empire of Mor Ardain, in particular from the Collection Point near Turbine Tower leading down to the Mine No. 2 Entrance. In the , Sunset Clovers can also be obtained by scanning an amiibo.
Sunlight Boomerangs are Treasure items in . They can be obtained through Salvaging at the Canyon of Husks in the Spirit Crucible Elpys.
Supersonic Spin (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Megalance.
Styrene Woodblocks are Tree collectibles in . They can be found in Elysium on the First Low Orbit Station.

Sygian Aspids (Japanese: , Sugia Asupīdo) are enemies in . They are members of the Aspid family, and can be found at level 45-47 in the Chamber of Pillars on the Lower Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys.

Surveillance is a Merc Mission in . It can be received in the Kingdom of Uraya automatically after unlocking the second row of Azami's Affinity Chart and after Mòrag has joined the party. It triggers her Blade Quest, All's Fair. The time required to complete this mission is indefinite, as the mission will not end until Genedd is talked to at Fonsa Myma Port. As such, dispatching Blades with the suggested "Focus" and "Fortitude" Field Skills will not provide any noticeable effect.
Svena Piranhax (Japanese: , Subēnyi Samon) are enemies in . They are members of the Piranhax family, and can be found at level 42-44 on Godsford Isle in the Leftherian Archipelago.

Sulya is an NPC in . He is a Gormotti boy who can be found on the west shore of Gormott's Coolley Lake from 7am to 4pm, and at the Saets Chief's Residence from 4pm to midnight. Sulya gives the quest Buoy Can't Swim.

Switch Parts 1 are an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Informant shop in the Argentum Trade Guild. It provides information about the Ether Bottle Key Item, obtained by Salvaging at Port Anangham in the Empire of Mor Ardain and needed for Bana's Secret Treasure.

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Sunlight Eye (Japanese: , Nitchū Meichū Appu) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It boosts the user's accuracy by up to 120% during the day (07:00 – 19:00). The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. For a similar equipment that activates during the night, check the Night Vision. __TOC__

|-|Aux Core = |-|Skill RAM/Upgrade = Swift Evasion (Japanese: , Idō Kaihi) is an Aux Core or a Skill RAM/Upgrade in and . It increases the user's Evasion Rate by up to 35% while moving. The Skill RAM/Upgrade variants can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__

Senator Stulc Arascain (Japanese: , Sutōru-giin) is an NPC in . He is an Ardainian who can be found at Hardhaigh Palace in the Empire of Mor Ardain. He gives the Quest Insurgent Investigations, along with the related Defeat Arrodh, Defeat Bhianc and Defeat Wiggins. After the events of Insurgent Investigations he can be found near Grian, Wing Area #2.
Sworlbugs are Insect collectibles in . They can be found in the Spirit Crucible Elpys, specifically at the Collection Points on the upper level of the Chamber of Offering.

Summer Concert is a Merc Mission in . It can be received at the Argentum Trade Guild during the Blade Quest Bearing Her Soul, after Ursula obtains 2,000 fans. The time required to complete this mission is 30 minutes, but it can be reduced down to 8 minutes by dispatching Blades with the "Ice Mastery" and "Electric Mastery" Field Skills. It rewards stamps that are necessary to level up Ursula's attributes. It also increases Ursula's fanbase by a significant amount.

Sweeper Lysaats (Japanese: , Suīpā Shīsu) are Story Exclusive Enemies in . They are members of the Lysaat family, and can be found at level 7 - 9 at the Cloud Tank Chamber of the Titan Battleship in the Gormott Province during Chapters 2, 3 and 4.
Surprise Shot is a Driver Art in . It is one of Nia's arts when using a Decimation Cannon.

Surprise Elbow (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using a Calamity Scythe. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Spinning Elbow.

Sublime Lariat (Japanese: ) is a Driver Art in . It is one of Zeke's arts when using Rockrending Gauntlets. It can be obtained upon New Game Plus, after finishing the game and installing Patch (Ver.1.3.0). This art recycles Zeke's Hammer Lariat.

Swift Strike is a Skill RAM/Upgrade in . It increases damage dealt by up to 100% during the first 30 seconds of a battle. It can be used to customize Poppi α, Poppi QT and Poppi QTπ as an Aux Core equivalent. __TOC__
Switch Parts 2 is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Garfont Village Informant for 10,000 G or rewarded upon completion of the Merc Mission Three Parts.

Switch Parts 3 is an Info Item in . It can be purchased from the Fonsa Myma Informant for 10,000 G or rewarded upon completion of the Merc Mission Three Parts.

Sugar Wisps (Japanese: , Shugā Ranpusu) are enemies in . They are members of the Wisp family and can be found at level 20-27 in the Kingdom of Uraya.

Sweet Strategy is a Heart-to-Heart in . It requires Gorg in the party when sleeping at Anastatia's to unlock. It is located near Theosoir's Main Gate in the Kingdom of Tantal. It features a conversation between Gorg, his Driver and Tora. The quest Follow Your Passion follows on from this Heart to Heart which allows Gorg to improve his "Patissier" Field Skill.

Stronger than Light is a Heart-to-Heart in . It is located just below the bridge of the Central Pathway in the Decaying Titan in the Land of Morytha. It features a conversation between Zenobia, her Driver, and Mythra.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Sunlight Chokers (Japanese: , Taiyō no Chōkā) are DLC accessories in . They increase the wearer's Luck stat by up to 37%. They are the upgraded version of the Nacre Choker, Goddess Choker and Comet Choker accessories. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass. For a similar additive effect that can stack with this gear, check the Bunnit Choker and Gold Gear Choker accessories. Outside of combat, they slightly improve the odds of bonding with Rare Blades during Blade Resonance.

The Sword Serprond (Japanese: , Sōdo Rodon) is a Challenge Battle Enemy in . It is a member of the Serprond family that is fought at level 68 during Wave 5 of the Challenge Battle Darkening Skies. This enemy drops no items. Although named a Serprond, this enemy uses the model of a Marrin. The Blizzard Lexos in the same battle is similarly misnamed.

Svelte Ignas (Japanese: , Suveru Igūna) are Challenge Battle Enemies in . They are members of the Igna family that are fought at level 104 during Wave 2 of the Challenge Battle Humanoid Alliance. This enemy drops no items.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Survivor's Footgears (Japanese: , Seikansha no Kutsu) are DLC accessories in and . They make the wearer take up to 30% less damage from enemy attacks, in exchange of decreasing their damage output by up to 60%. They are the upgraded version of the Envoy's Footgear accessory. They can be found in the Land of Challenge from Treasure Troves obtained after completing a Challenge Battle, available as downloadable content from the Challenge Battle Mode Pack of the Expansion Pass.

is the fifth installment in the Super Smash Bros series (sixth if the two versions of are counted as separate titles). The game was directed by Masahiro Sakurai. As with , elements of the appear in the game, most notably with Shulk, Pyra, and Mythra being playable fighters. The game was released worldwide on December 7th, 2018.
